svg.title: From reviewed documents to inspectable evidence.
svg.desc: Reviewed documents are prepared explicitly. Runtime reads vectors and versioned chunks, validates evidence and returns citations. The local Chainlit viewer separately fetches the generation-specific S3 original and checks its SHA-256 hash.
svg.text: From reviewed documents to inspectable evidence.
Three separate paths: prepare the corpus, answer a question, then inspect the original.
Retain the original document for later inspection
The Runtime reads retrieval data. Original PDFs are opened through the separate local viewer below.
Local viewer → private S3 → original PDF
The viewer uses its local AWS profile. Runtime access to chunks does not grant original-document access.
Custom document RAG using S3 Vectors. Document preparation is separate from live restaurant search.
Comparisons can use up to two workers; optional hybrid retrieval combines BM25 with vector rankings.
